name: B10-0114/2024 (The Left) – The cases of unjustly imprisoned Uyghurs in China, notably Ilham Tohti and Gulshan Abbas
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the cases of unjustly imprisoned Uyghurs in China, notably Ilham Tohti and Gulshan Abbas
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on China to release Ilham Tohti, Gulshan Abbas and other Uyghurs it says are wrongly imprisoned. It asks China to stop repressing Uyghurs in Xinjiang and to let prisoners see their families and chosen lawyers. It also asks the United Nations to report again on Xinjiang and to set up a body to investigate rights abuses there. The text is the Parliament's opinion and request; it does not change any law itself.

- Nothing changes in law yet; the Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- The requests target China's government, UN bodies, and the families of the imprisoned Uyghurs.
- Next, the resolution is sent to China, UN officials and European Union governments; follow-up depends on them.
